label: Dark Charcoal
description: Dark charcoal lining occupies the tonal space between black and navy, offering a sober, serious interior that blends effortlessly with grey, charcoal, and dark blue outer fabrics without the stark formality of pure black. It is particularly popular in English business suiting where the overall look is one of controlled authority, and the near-neutral dark tone means the lining never distracts from the cloth's surface. Charcoal Bemberg cupro also ages gracefully without showing the yellowing or fading that lighter linings can develop over time.
